answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The vertex holds work receipts rather than names, so the harbor of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the wharf of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
